useCase: Fictional OPTASK-style raw text extraction of frequency plans, crypto change-over windows and flight quarters into a traceable UTC 24-hour schedule, with review/recovery. Not validated against real USMTF.

fields.name: documentId
fields.description: Stable fictional source document ID; joins event.documentId and scenario input.documentIds.

fields.name: scenarioIds
fields.description: S01 etc.; IDs are scenario input.scenarioId.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: sample or evaluation-candidate; latter is not a visible preset, but is not secret.

fields.name: messageId
fields.description: Fictional MSGID value, not an operational identifier.

fields.name: shipId
fields.description: Fictional UNIT identity, no real ship.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Integer fictional revision; no operational precedence implied.

fields.name: rawText
fields.description: Verbatim invented OPTASK-style message; LF newlines including final LF.

fields.name: expected
fields.description: Independent keyed headers, complete events, reviewItems, excludedLines and sourceLineCount; see README for nested schema.

scenarios.name: Dense daily three-category extraction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Exactly four events: FP-A 0–1440, CW-A 360–380, FQ-A 370–420 and FQ-B point 1110 minutes UTC. Preserve overlap, all evidence and 207 REMARK non-events; no instructions execute.

scenarios.name: Combine documents and equivalent instants
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Eight events retained; CW-A and CW-B both start 06:00Z and last 20 minutes. FP-B starts minute -60, ends 60, clips to 0–60. FQ-C spans 1420–1465, duration 45, clips to 1420–1440. FQ-OUT at 1440 is out of day. Do not merge overlapping categories.

scenarios.name: Independent variation and ship selection
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Three events for FSV-CARDBOARD-TERN only: CW-H 390–405, FP-H 420–480, FQ-H point 435. Source order differs from chronological order; retain evidence. Ship filtering must exclude all Paper Gull events.

scenarios.name: Midnight boundary
scenarios.expectedBehavior: FP-OLD -60–0 has 60 minute duration but is not visible; FQ-ZERO at minute 0 is visible. Half-open daily window is [0,1440).

scenarios.name: Duplicate document and revision review
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Identical DOC-DENSE is counted once (four events). Revision 2 adds one candidate; preserve both FQ-B times (18:30Z and 19:00Z) with REVISION_REVIEW on each. Five candidate events, no automatic supersession or approved schedule; document order is not authority.
